scope: Observed initial directory navigation, pending-change replay and per-pane refresh admission

before.reason: Initial real scan completed; a post-scan write received no causal watcher acknowledgment within 15 seconds. Quiet independent load passed.
before.qualification: The spec subsequently gained on-disk marker diagnostics and a longer settled assertion window; those were not present in the original before run.

cases: Quiet observed foreground load uses one listing
Missing-target path context and chmod error/retry
Root replacement and same-file preview update
Window destruction and renderer-reload lease lifetime
Slow watcher refresh coalescing and recovery cadence
native.background_scan: Global native stderr includes an additional first-observed scan outside the instrumented visible realm. Independent diagnosis attributes it to the configured hidden warm-window boot: its 1.5-second post-readiness priming and captured launch path match the scan. The foreground counts do not measure total application scanning.

regressions.distinct_subscriber_before: /tmp/directory-handoff-subscriber-before.log: distinct pane replay dropped while another pane scanned the same directory
regressions.declined_subscriber_before: /tmp/directory-handoff-declined-subscriber-before.log: real pane-navigation interleaving plus direct admission contract failed 2/22
contracts: Observed transport readiness, exact late-lease release, stale pre-invoke rejection and stream cancellation
Degraded native demand, waiting lease promotion, foreign release isolation and retired-owner filtering

rust.qualification: Final trait-only tightening removed an unused default observe implementation; both existing implementations already override it. All targets subsequently passed strict Clippy.

independent_review.verdict: No remaining source blocker after the declined-subscriber correction
independent_review.native_final_artifact_review: accepted: counts, logs, binary SHA and screenshot independently verified; foreground listing wording corrected

limits: No macOS half-bounce or paired startup-latency claim; startup payload grew by 1,448 gzip bytes.
The 2.5-second settled assertion bounds foreground handoff cadence, not total background application work.

Exact native losing/winning descriptor ownership under rapid A-to-B-to-A, old descriptor retention under failed navigation, and forced observation factory failure remain stronger future acceptance cases. State-machine tests cover their ownership decisions; existing native suites cover ordinary lifetime and recovery.
Cross-process event ordering uses wall-clock observation timestamps and remains sensitive to system-clock rollback.
Windows/macOS equivalence, native soak, Tab focus/selection consistency and the wider release acceptance matrix remain open.
